# bitbucket_pipeline_config (Resource)

Enables or disables Bitbucket Pipelines for a repository. There is exactly one of these per repository: destroying this resource disables Pipelines again, it does not delete the repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_pipeline_config" "api" {
  repository_slug = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  enabled         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Pipelines is enabled for the repository.
- `repository_slug` (String) Slug of the repository to configure.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/repository_slug".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_pipeline_config.api payments-api
```
